text: In 1938, an entire English town hunted a man who never existed.
This is Halifax. Dark streets, thick fog, and very nervous people.
One November night, two women say a man jumped them with a mallet.
They didn't see his face. But they did notice his shiny shoe buckles.
Days later, another woman says he cut her. Then another. Then a man.
Now the town has a name for him. The Halifax Slasher.
Shops close early. Nobody walks alone. And the men form patrols.
Armed with sticks, they beat the shit out of anyone who looks slightly slashy.
One guy runs to help a victim, and the mob decides he's the slasher and chants for his head.
Scotland Yard sends detectives up from London.
You see, a rumor is like a streetlamp in fog. It doesn't show you more. It just makes every shadow look bigger.
Then one victim, Percy, admits he cut himself. Then another admits it. And another.
There was no slasher. No mallet. No buckles.
Five locals were charged with public mischief, and four went to prison.
The only people the Halifax Slasher ever hurt were the people hunting him.
